title: Bodegas Ribera del Alba
summary: The partial document covers the annual report of Bodegas Ribera del Alba for the year 2025. It includes sections on the introduction of the winery, details about the vineyards and grape varieties, the 2025 harvest, winemaking and aging processes, sales and markets, and future projects for 2026.

title: Presentación de la bodega
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
- The establishment and family ownership of Bodegas Ribera del Alba since 1972.
- The vineyard area of 148 hectares owned by the bodega in Tobalina.
- The current workforce consisting of 34 permanent employees and 60 seasonal workers during harvest time.
- The complete renovation of the barrel room and bottling room in 2019.

title: Viñedos y variedades
summary: The main points covered in the partial document are the varietal composition of the vineyard, the altitude range of the vineyards, and the training methods used. Specifically, it mentions that tempranillo comprises 62%, garnacha 21%, verdejo 12%, and other varieties make up the remaining 5%. The vineyards are situated between 720 and 860 meters of altitude, with an average of 780 meters. The training method is in vaso for older parcels planted between 1974 and 1988, while newer parcels use the espaldera method.

title: Vendimia 2025
summary:
The main points covered in the partial document are:
- The start and end dates of the 2025 harvest: September 22 to October 18.
- The total amount of grapes harvested: 912,000 kilograms.
- The average yield per hectare: 6,100 kilograms.
- The grapes entered the harvest in good condition with higher acidity compared to the previous year (2024).
- A particularly cold night in October caused a delay in the harvest of one week, affecting the initial schedule.

title: Elaboración y crianza
summary: The partial document covers the elaboration and aging processes at a winery in 2025. Key points include the use of 420 oak barrels, with 60% being American oak and 40% French oak. The average aging period for red wines is 14 months. White wines are fermented in controlled temperature steel tanks at 15 degrees. Additionally, a small portion of garnacha is made using ancient amphorae since 2023.

title: Ventas y mercados
summary:
The partial document covers sales and market data for a product in 2025. Key points include:
- 340,000 bottles were sold
- 44% of sales were exports
- Main export markets: Germany (18% of sales) and the United States (11% of sales)
- Total revenue was 4.8 million euros, a 6% increase from 2024
- The average selling price for the aging range was 13.50 euros per bottle

title: Proyectos 2026
summary: The partial document covers two main points for 2026: the construction of a new bottling hall with automatic labeling that will double the current capacity, and the initiation of the finca Valdemoras' conversion to organic agriculture in March 2026, which is expected to take three campaigns until certification.
